messages:
lena: Quick FYI  spotted a few outdated SDK snippets in the 0.11 relnotes draft (PR 632). They still use `RedwoodClient`. Can someone grab this?

omar: I can. Paste one example so I know the mismatch.

lena: Example in whats-new/0.11.md: ```js
// old
const r = await RedwoodClient.generate({ prompt: 'hi' })
```

Should be: ```js
// new
const r = await redwood.infer.text({ input: 'hi' })
```

omar: Got it. I'll update the snippets gallery and the migration note. Also add a tiny mapping table: `RedwoodClient.generate -> redwood.infer.text`, `RedwoodClient.stream -> redwood.infer.stream`.

ci-bot: snippet-tests queued for PR 632...

omar: Also found a streaming mismatch. Our preview harness returns dict deltas; code sample uses attribute access. I'll add a one-line defensive shim: `token = d.get('token') or getattr(d, 'token', '')`. Keeps it compatible.

qa-zoe: Please ensure the migration guide links to SDK changelog PR 628. I'll re-run preview once you push.

ci-bot: snippet-tests PASS  all gallery snippets in PR 632 pass (Node 18, Python 3.11).

omar: Pushed fixes and updated frontmatter (release_date). Preview: https://docs.redwood.ai/preview/0.11

qa-zoe: Checked preview  codeblocks render and migration table looks good on mobile. Thumbs.

product-bot: Product requests a one-line, customer-friendly blurb about Adaptive routing; keep non-technical and include internal link.

lena: Added the single-sentence blurb and linked the roadmap per product format.

omar: Merged PR 632 after QA thumbs. Scheduling publish in the release window. Thanks all for the quick turnaround. :tada:
